purpose: Prepare immutable native-Git candidates and execute admitted fast-forwards through a reusable GitHub Actions workflow and GitHub-OIDC-gated Supabase Edge bridge.
candidatePreparation: Resolve the live native_git approval scope from Supabase.
Verify caller repository and workflow identity against the current target executor profile.
Verify the watched deployment branch still equals the signed source head.
Create an isolated candidate branch from that exact base.
Add one audit-only marker inside the configured trigger path.
Commit and push the isolated candidate branch.
Record the exact candidate commit SHA and marker SHA-256 in the append-only candidate ledger.
execution: Resolve an admitted native_git execution envelope.
Verify the watched branch still equals requiredBranchBaseSha.
Record fail-closed fast-forward start evidence before mutation.
Fast-forward the watched branch without force.
Verify the watched branch now equals candidateCommitSha.
Leave Railway deployment, health, provenance, attestation and release reconciliation as downstream Defence gates.

trust.callerRepository: Must equal the executor profile nativeGit.repository.
trust.callerWorkflow: Must equal the candidate or execution wrapper path stored in the current executor profile.
trust.reusableJobWorkflow: Must equal the exact Core reusable workflow ref and SHA stored in the current executor profile.

invariants: The ticket carries only an approvalId or executionId; repository, branch and commit scope come from live Defence state.
Candidate preparation never updates the watched deployment branch.
Execution uses a normal fast-forward push and never force-pushes.
No workflow may change Railway service configuration, variables, domains, replicas, sleep mode or rollback state.
A caller repository cannot act on another repository's target.
A changed caller workflow or reusable workflow SHA fails closed.
A changed watched-branch head fails closed before fast-forward.
Fast-forward receipt recording requires observedAfterSha to equal the admitted candidate SHA.
No credential values are persisted or returned.
